title: Height and setback modifications
previewText: For zoning lots in R5 Districts, without a letter suffix, utilizing the provisions of Section 23-72, inclusive, the following height and setback modifications shall apply: the height and setback regulations applicable to an R5B District set forth in Section 23-422 (Basic flat-roof envelopes for certain districts) shall apply.
